extractions.label: upgrades
extractions.expression: (() => { const h=idleon.getAttr('Holes'),lists=idleon.getAttr('CustomLists').h, gate=!!idleon.callFunction('Holes','CanWeEnhanceCosmo',0,0), remaining=idleon.callFunction('Holes','CosmoPtsLeft',0,0); let id=-1; return lists.CosmoUpgrades.flatMap((rows,tree)=>rows.flatMap((row,position)=>{ id++; if(row[2]==='Confused_Bonus')return []; const level=Number(h[4+tree][position]),cap=1+(gate?idleon.callFunction('Holes','EnhanceMaxLV',tree,position):0),prerequisiteMet=position===0||Number(h[4+tree][position-1])>0; return {id,tree,position,name:row[2],level,initial:Math.min(1,level),enhancement:Math.max(0,level-1),gate,cap,prerequisiteId:position===0?null:id-1,prerequisiteMet,access:Number(h[1][2])>=1,canPurchase:Number(h[1][2])>=1&&prerequisiteMet&&level<cap&&remaining>=1,bonus:idleon.callFunction('Holes','CosmoBonusQTY',tree,position)}; })); })()
extractions.description: Original tree positions preserve placeholder gaps; caps and predecessor rules follow the purchase caller.
